versions.name: Camp Geronimo

features.note: Fish Camp, an angling program run with Trout Unlimited covering Fishing and Fly-Fishing merit badges.
Part of Geronimo DIY, a vocational track working on real camp facilities.
A drone flight school teaching aviation physics through STEM challenges.
Brownsea Island Adventure, a transitional program for Scouts new to a troop.
Spade Ranch Adventure is an a la carte program for older youth and adults.
Spade Ranch Adventure combines climbing, canyoneering, caving, horseback riding, canoeing, and mountain biking.

versions.summary: Scouts BSA week-long resident summer camp operated by the Grand Canyon Council, set below the Mogollon Rim north of Payson, Arizona.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence).
